title: BROKE BLOCK
description: Changes the animation of destroying blocks to 512x natural animation
body:
The idea for this resource pack was inspired by a natural phenomenon - when electricity passes through a tree and leaves a burned mark. These are not tree branches, but the texture is very similar.

![1](https://i.postimg.cc/Zqc7b7nC/123321.png)
real wooden lines

The texture pack for breaking blocks has a resolution of 512x - thanks to the compressor, I was able to compress this pack from 10 MB to 1 MB. At the same time, I was able to preserve the quality that was there from the very beginning.


![2](https://i.postimg.cc/HWPN8h2M/GLASS.gif)

Here is how this animation looks like in the game when interacting with different blocks.

![3](https://i.postimg.cc/RFpgfWcm/DIAMOND.gif)


![4](https://i.postimg.cc/fLRHJcS5/STONE.gif)

![5](https://i.postimg.cc/zGY0nZRy/WOOD.gif)

THANKS FOR WATCHING - ENJOY!
